Outputs from the 175B InstructGPT model are preferred to 175B GPT-3 outputs **85 ± 3%** of the time. Against few-shot 175B GPT-3, they are preferred **71 ± 4%** of the time. The paper states these numbers on page 3 (Introduction) and again on page 11 (Section 4.1).

Context:
- Labelers rated the models on the test set, which uses prompts from held-out customers who are not in the training data (page 2).
- "Few-shot GPT-3" means GPT-3 given a few-shot prefix to "prompt" it into following instructions (page 9).
- Unless stated otherwise, "InstructGPT" means the PPO-ptx models (page 9).
